v2_vs_v1.v1_used_in_prior_commit_0b9836b: v1 native kernel requires single smooth Iphase segment; we forced each crust to its Iphase 0 (outer, lowest-density) segment. The 1e-12 mass gate passed 65/65 but every pair then failed the v1 stability gate because the Iphase 0 outer segment is non-monotone in P(mu_B) / has cs2 <= 0 -- not a valid smooth low-density phase.
v2_vs_v1.v2_now: v2 segments each input at its internal Iphase boundaries and runs the v1 kernel on the (LAST low segment, FIRST high segment) pair = densest crust segment vs least-dense core segment. This is the physically relevant crust-core coexistence candidate, using a crust segment that is actually smooth at the matching density. v1 is UNCHANGED; v2 is opt-in via construct_maxwell_transition_v2.

regeneration.what: Q3/Q4/Q6/Q7 re-derived for PDG m_n; multi-Iphase preserved (NOT filtered to a single segment); Q1/Q2/Q5/Iphase/composition/n_B grid unchanged
regeneration.NOT_a_gauge_shift: Both phases regenerated to the same PDG m_n/m_p with Q3/Q4/Q6/Q7 re-derived; physical F/P/mu_B/mu_Q invariant. NOT a gauge shift (gauge shift applies dmcr to ONE phase only and adds dmcr to F).
regeneration.distinction_from_prior_matched_regenerat: matched_regenerated/ used original gauges; its v1 Maxwell failed 65/65 at the 1e-12 mass gate. This v2 run uses PDG-regenerated sources so the mass gate passes; v2 then runs the stability/coexistence physics gates on the physically relevant segment pair.

stability_gate_diagnosis.what_validate_phase_checks: compose_eos_phase_transition.f90:154 validate_phase builds a cubic Hermite interpolant P(mu_B) on each interval using P'(mu)=n_B (thermodynamic identity dP/dmu_B = n_B), then checks n>0, dn/dmu>0, and mu*dn/dmu - n >= 0 (the last is c_s^2/c^2 <= 1) over the WHOLE interval via the exact quadratic vertex, not just the endpoints.
stability_gate_diagnosis.why_endpoints_pass_but_interval_fails: Endpoints can be strictly monotone while the cubic Hermite bulges: for SPG_M1 Iphase 7, interval i=0 (nb 2.5119e-3 -> 2.5704e-3) has n0,n1 increasing but the interpolant's dn/dmu dips to -4.79e-3 at the midpoint (t=0.531, mu=941.136 MeV). This is a genuine interpolation artifact of the coarse n_B grid at the segment's low-density edge, not a mass-convention artifact.
stability_gate_diagnosis.implication: No (crust, core) pair produces a smooth-enough crust segment at the crust-core boundary for a sharp Maxwell coexistence under v1/v2's strict Hermite stability gate. The earlier m7_batch_v2 smooth matrix excluded sharp Maxwell for this same reason (M5 scope); it is NOT a mass-convention issue. The PDG-gauge regeneration succeeded in eliminating the mass gate (0/65 mass failures vs 65/65 in the prior matched_regenerated v1 run) but the crust segment Hermite stability gate remains.
